title: 第3章 王者归来第4章 不识货的族人
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
李族在临风城是一个大族，与慕容族，赵族，王族并称临风四雄，实力雄厚，府邸占地极广，里面房屋殿宇众多，景观雅致。
演武场内。
此时有一位美妇正抱着一名气息奄奄的壮硕少年哭泣，对着不远处神色冷漠的少年怒吼道：“李天，你们是同族兄弟啊，你为什么要下如此死手，打断我儿的手脚，废掉他的经脉，让他成为残疾。”
“是他自己找死，在上擂台之前，我早说过拳脚无眼，刀剑无情，上台比赛就要接受失败死亡的结局，我饶他一命，已经很仁慈了。”
李天态度冰冷，瞥了一眼鲜血淋漓的李凡，没有一丝愧疚。
“族长，你不是说过这是普通族比吗？现在李天将我儿打成重伤，按照家规该如何处置？”
美妇将愤怒的眼神投向首位坐着的族长李长青。
“叶雅，这是我的疏忽，没有及时救下李凡，我自会处置李天，你先让李凡服下丹药疗伤。”
李长青飞过来，递出一颗极品淬体丹，送到美妇手中，然后脸色阴沉喝道：“李天，族内相残是大忌，你忘了祖训吗，今日我将当着众长老与族人的面，按照族规处罚你，还李凡一个公道。”
“族长，我只是失手了。”
李天一脸淡然，丝毫没有伤人之后的内疚，害怕。
“你这是失手吗，我都叫你停手了，你还在对李凡下狠手，今日我一定要处置你，给李凡一个交代。”
李长青勃然大怒，就要前去拿下李天。
这时，首位靠左第一个位置的大长老站起身来，宏声道：“族长，我孙儿只是正当防卫，你刚刚也看到了李凡攻势有多猛，他主修肉身，一拳将我孙儿都打得吐血了。
今日世子之争，本就说好了胜者为世子，现在我孙儿获胜，应该当世子。”
“大长老，你别护着李天，他对族人如此心狠手辣，我必须好好教训，免得他走上歧路。”
李长青瞪了大长老一眼。
李家能传承千年，成为临风城四大家族之一，靠的就是团结一心，若今日不处罚李天，族心将会涣散。
二长老站起身来，严肃道：“我赞同惩罚李天，我李族以团结立足，容不下这等歹毒的子嗣。”
“族长，三个月前，我被天剑宗第二峰的峰主选为了真传弟子，师尊还赐了我一颗聚元丹，是一颗上品宝丹，助我突破到了先天境大圆满，要不了一年，我就能晋升元府境，你要为一个废物处罚我吗？

那我就叛出李族。”
李天扬起脖子，一脸高傲，说话间，他不再隐藏实力，释放出先天境大圆满的气息。
李长青心中一凛。
丹药等级为灵丹，玄丹，宝丹，金丹，圣丹，道丹，帝丹，天丹，仙丹。
一颗上品宝丹价值十万下品灵石，且有价无市，天剑宗第二峰峰主舍得送出，可见他对李天的器重。
如今李天有这样的背景，李长青不得不重新衡量。
李族虽为临风城四大家族之一，但与庞然大物天剑宗比起来，那简直是小巫见大巫，不值一提。
“我的天，李天真是妖孽啊，三年间突飞猛进，从炼气七层突破至先天境大圆满，这就是进入天剑宗的巨大好处吗？”
“唉，李天的这个名额还是顶替失踪的李易才得到的，没想到他却用来打伤李易的亲弟弟李凡。”
“嘘，你小声点，现在李天今非昔比，别说这些话来招惹他，小心他打断你的腿，撕烂你的嘴。”
……
演武场四周议论纷纷，对李天充满惊叹与佩服，以及畏惧。
“以李天现在的实力与地位，当我族的世子是实至名归，我赞同现在就立李天为世子，至于他打伤李凡这事，只是失手而已，并无过错。”
得知李天的地位提升后，三长老当即表态站队。
四长老劝道：“族长，决斗难免有死伤，对于真气的掌控，我们尚且做不到收发自如，李天才十八岁不到，哪能分毫不差的掌控。
他打伤李凡完全是无心之失，不必过多苛责。
我认为现在应该立李天为世子，扬我族威。”
在四长老看来，李族能有子嗣进入天剑宗，成为真传弟子，这是莫大的福分与机缘，可不能因为一个粗陋的莽夫得罪了他。
“我也赞同立李天为世子，李易消失了三年，我们等了他三年，也算是仁至义尽，如今李天彰显出龙凤之姿，成为世子是众望所归。”
五长老跟着附和。

“对了，我还有一件事忘了公布，在师尊的引导下，我激活了隐藏的天狼之体，属于极品皇体，师尊说我未来不可限量。”
李天高傲道。
content_en:
The Li clan is a large clan in Linfeng City. Together with the Murong clan, the Zhao clan, and the royal clan, they are also known as the four heroes of Linfeng. They are powerful, and their mansion occupies a very large area with many houses and palaces and elegant landscapes.
In the martial arts arena.
At this time, a beautiful woman was holding a dying strong young man and crying, and yelled at the cold-looking young man not far away: "Li Tian, you are brothers of the same race, why did you do such a cruel thing, break my son's hands and feet, destroy his meridians, and make him disabled."
"He was looking for death on his own. Before he entered the ring, I had already said that fists and feet have no eyes and swords are ruthless. When we compete on stage, we must accept the outcome of failure and death. I spared his life, which is already very merciful."
Li Tian's attitude was cold and he glanced at the bloody Li Fan without any trace of guilt.
"Clan leader, didn't you say that this is a normal clan competition? Now that Li Tian has severely injured my son, how should I deal with it according to family rules?"
The beautiful woman cast her angry eyes at the first sitting patriarch, Li Changqing.
"Ye Ya, this was my negligence. I didn't save Li Fan in time. I will deal with Li Tian myself. You first let Li Fan take the elixir to heal his injuries."
Li Changqing flew over, handed out a top-quality body-tempering pill, and delivered it to the beautiful woman's hand. Then he shouted with a gloomy face: "Li Tian, it is a taboo to kill each other within the clan. Have you forgotten the ancestral teachings? Today, in front of all the elders and clan members, I will punish you according to the clan rules and give Li Fan justice."
"Clan leader, I just made a mistake."
Li Tian looked indifferent, showing no guilt or fear after hurting someone.
"Did you make a mistake? I told you to stop, but you are still ruthless to Li Fan. I must deal with you today and give Li Fan an explanation."
Li Changqing was furious and was about to go and capture Li Tian.
At this time, the first elder standing on the left stood up and said loudly: "Clan leader, my grandson was just defending himself. You just saw how fierce Li Fan's offensive was. He majored in the physical body and beat my grandson with one punch until he vomited blood.
In today's battle for the heir apparent, it was originally agreed that the winner would be the heir apparent. Now that my grandson has won, he should be the heir apparent. "
"Great Elder, don't protect Li Tian. He is so cruel to the clan members. I must teach him a lesson to prevent him from going astray."
Li Changqing glared at the great elder.
The Li family has been able to inherit the family for thousands of years and become one of the four major families in Linfeng City because of unity. If Li Tian is not punished today, the family will be scattered.
The second elder stood up and said seriously: "I agree to punish Li Tian. Our Li clan is based on unity and cannot tolerate such vicious heirs."
"Patriarch, three months ago, I was selected as a true disciple by the master of the second peak of the Tianjian Sect. The master also gave me a Yuan Gathering Pill, a high-grade treasure pill, which helped me break through to the Great Perfection of the Xiantian Realm. In less than a year, I will be promoted to the Yuanfu Realm. Do you want to punish me for being a waste?
Then I will betray the Li clan. "
Li Tian raised his neck with a proud look on his face. As he spoke, he no longer concealed his strength and released the aura of great perfection in the innate realm.
Li Changqing's heart trembled.
The levels of elixirs are spiritual elixir, mysterious elixir, treasure elixir, golden elixir, holy elixir, Tao elixir, emperor elixir, heaven elixir and elixir elixir.
A high-grade treasure pill is worth 100,000 low-grade spiritual stones, and there is no market for it. The master of the second peak of Tianjian Sect is willing to give it away, which shows how much he values ​​Li Tian.
Now that Li Tian has such a background, Li Changqing has to reassess.
Although the Li family is one of the four major families in Linfeng City, compared with the behemoth Tianjian Sect, it is simply dwarfed and not worth mentioning.
"My God, Li Tianzhen is such a monster. He has made rapid progress in three years, breaking through from the seventh level of Qi Refining to the Great Perfection of the Xiantian Realm. Is this the huge benefit of joining the Tianjian Sect?"
"Alas, Li Tian got this spot in place of the missing Li Yi. Unexpectedly, he used it to injure Li Yi's brother Li Fan."
"Shh, keep your voice down. Li Tian is not what he used to be now. Don't provoke him by saying these things. Be careful that he breaks your legs.Tear your mouth apart. "
…
There was a lot of discussion around the martial arts arena, full of admiration, admiration, and fear for Li Tian.
"With Li Tian's current strength and status, he deserves to be the crown prince of our clan. I agree to make Li Tian the crown prince now. As for the fact that he injured Li Fan, it was just a mistake and he was not at fault. "
After learning that Li Tian's status had been improved, the third elder immediately expressed his support.
The Fourth Elder advised: "Clan Chief, there will inevitably be casualties in a duel. Regarding the control of the true energy, we are still unable to send and receive it freely. Li Tiancai is less than eighteen years old, how can he control it perfectly.
It was an unintentional mistake for him to hurt Li Fan, so there is no need to be too harsh on him.
I think it is time to make Li Tian the crown prince to promote the prestige of our clan. "
In the eyes of the fourth elder, it is a great blessing and opportunity for the Li clan to have a descendant enter the Tianjian Sect and become a true disciple, but he cannot be offended by a crude and reckless man.
"I also agree to make Li Tian the crown prince. Li Yi disappeared for three years, and we waited for him for three years, which can be regarded as the most benevolent and righteous. Now Li Tian has shown the appearance of a dragon and a phoenix, and becoming the crown prince is what everyone expects. "
The fifth elder followed suit.
"By the way, there is one more thing I forgot to announce. Under the guidance of Master, I activated the hidden body of Sirius, which is a top-grade imperial body. Master said that my future is limitless. "
Li Tian said arrogantly.
